notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK corpus for standard-invalid FOM inputs. The adapter supplies the provider package, valid baseline FOM, invalid FOM modules, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. Each invalid module is submitted through the standard single-module Create Federation Execution service and must be rejected with one of the standard FOM-related exception classes; the same federation name is then reused for a valid create, join, resign, destroy, and disconnect lifecycle. The contract deliberately does not assert provider-specific diagnostic text, error ordering, registries, headers, or implementation details, and it is not a complete OMT conformance claim.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador single-FOM Create Federation Execution rejection and post-failure lifecycle atomicity
